summary: Add reusable transcript grammar primitives and a pairing preview without migrating existing families

replay.detail: Pure kit props; no source records or replay changes.

rules.detail: Marker boundaries are unframed; routine rows are one line; only failed/aborted, human interjections, incoming messages, open questions and expanded results promote to cards. Failed/aborted cards remain expanded. Text-only bodies and typed actions prevent nested cards. Status accents affect glyphs, tags and card hairlines, not labels.

compatibility.detail: Additive root kit exports: TranscriptMarker(label, glyph?, alignment?), TranscriptRow(glyph, verb, subject, excerpt?, tone?, tag?, meta?, disclosure?), TranscriptCard(header, promotion, body, actions?, disclosure?), TranscriptTag(label, tone?), TranscriptMeta(timestamp, now, durationMs?, timeZone?, locale?) and TranscriptGlyph(name, tone?). Tone is neutral/running/attention/danger. Existing families are intentionally unchanged pending adoption. Card disclosure preserves the header and keyboard focus across promotion.

accessibility.detail: Shared light fgFaint text ink is #6b6b73 in semantic and compatibility themes; dark ink and border tokens are unchanged. Affected existing consumers include DiffPanel disabled/unavailable hints, gutters and hunk controls; Shell disabled controls and drawer hints/range labels; Sidebar idle indicators; Workbench placeholder hints/resource chips; and transcript excerpts. Light preview plays require small-text contrast of at least 4.5:1 on canvas, raised/card and message surfaces, with the previous low-contrast ink as a failing control. Disclosure chevrons render at 12px using geometry tokens.

manual.detail: Transcript grammar Storybook previews document tiers, semantic promotion, type scale, glyphs, tags, explicit-clock ages and durations at compact/wide widths in both themes. This proposal stays draft until pairing ratification. Type/rhythm roles derive from composition tokens: items and actions use the 6px rhythm; deliberate inner spacing is 2px card top inset, 4px body/action separation and tag inset, 8px card horizontal padding. formatDuration accepts finite nonnegative milliseconds and floors seconds. formatRelativeAge takes explicit finite Date-range timestamps (inclusive ±8.64e15 ms), clamps future ages to zero and returns label/dateTime/absolute. Absolute tooltips default to the viewer's Intl locale and time zone; optional locale/timeZone overrides support deterministic stories. Rows show only relative ages. Invalid clock inputs throw RangeError. Property tests reuse the web package's existing Vitest and fast-check dependencies without modifying protected kit manifests.

recovery.detail: No state migration or recovery changes.
